notes.title: Soulkin Update v1.1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/9c129ffdc2e38cc0109b02986a66821a91c7bec3.png[/img]

[h1]Soulkin Update v1.1.3 – Tutorial Tweaks, Gamepad Improvements & New SFX[/h1]

Hey adventurers!

A new patch is live for Soulkin! This update brings enhancements to the tutorial, gamepad navigation upgrades, new sound effects, and another round of polish and fixes to improve your journey through Ankiril.

Here’s what’s new in v1.1.3:

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Tutorial Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the battlefield layout in the first tutorial fight to improve navigation with a gamepad.
[*] Moved the dashboard tutorial from the third battle to the second, for better pacing and flow.
[*] Minor text tweaks for clarity.
[/list]
[h3]New Sound Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various new SFX have been added throughout the game to enhance feedback and immersion—from battle moments to UI interactions.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes and Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Trinket “Use” button would appear outside of battle.
[*] Resolved an issue where tooltip popups would flash during the level-up screen when using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where multiple battlefields could be created when starting a run.
[*] The Options button now displays properly over blurred backgrounds—like crystal and soul counters.
[*] Added an animation when gaining HP with Bonpon, making health changes more noticeable.
[*] Improved hex-grid navigation when using a gamepad, especially near map edges.
[*] Added a movement highlight effect showing where a selected Soulkin or Nadia can move.
[/list]

We hope these changes make the adventure even smoother and more immersive—especially for new players and those on controller. Thanks as always for playing and for sharing your feedback!

See you in Ankiril,
—The Tambù Games Team

notes.title: Soulkin Update v1.1.2 – Tutorial, Visual Upgrades & Fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/84a14ead917e9a2e8dda866cc9fe2963b3ab2f7c.png[/img]

[h1]Soulkin Update v1.1.2 – Tutorial, Visual Upgrades & Fixes![/h1]

Hey adventurers!

A fresh update has arrived for Soulkin—introducing a brand-new tutorial experience, visual improvements, and a round of fixes to enhance stability and clarity across the board.

Here’s what’s new in v1.1.2:

[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Tutorial Now Available[/h3]
New to Ankiril? We’ve added a guided tutorial that walks you through the basics of Soulkin’s systems, strategy, and flow.
[list]
[*] It launches automatically on new save files.
[*] Already playing? You can replay it via the Options menu (Gear icon at the top right of the screen).
⚠️ [i]Note: launching the tutorial with an active run will erase your current progress—use with care![/i]
[/list]

[h3]New Visuals & UI Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] New medal animation at the end of completed runs!
[*] Minor graphical improvements across screens.
[*] Cleaned up menu UI: the gear icon now handles settings; the old text button has been removed.
[*] Adjusted tooltip placement so they no longer block interactable elements.
[*] Refined end-of-run popups to better communicate key info.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes & Polish[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare bug where the hex selector would activate randomly in battle.
[*] Resolved issue where language changes wouldn’t apply mid-run.
[*] Fixed AutoHeal skills so they now ignore Soulkin already at full health.
[*] Corrected UI issues on ultrawide resolutions.
[*] Fixed a bug where level-up upgrades didn’t appear at Kotheren and Fijord shops.
[*] Fixed various text overflow issues across the UI.
[/list]

We hope this patch helps new players ease into the world of Soulkin and makes your overall experience smoother and more enjoyable. As always, thanks for playing and for your continued feedback!

See you in Ankiril,
—The Tambu Games Team

notes.title: v1.0 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/16887b3ef8d823a1398248f3c1193ca95cc016b7.png[/img]

[h1]🎉 Soulkin 1.0 Is Live! 🎉[/h1]
Hello, adventurers!

The day has arrived—Soulkin is officially out of Early Access and fully launched!
After months of iteration, balancing, and your incredible feedback, we’re proud to present the 1.0 version of Soulkin, packed with new features, polish, and improvements that bring the game to a whole new level.

Whether you’ve been with us from the start or you’re jumping in for the first time—welcome to Ankiril.

[h2]🌟 What’s New in 1.0?[/h2]
We’ve worked hard to refine every part of the game, from combat and exploration to user experience and performance. Here's what you can expect in this full release:

[h3]🎮 Full Controller Support[/h3]
Grab your favorite gamepad and play your way—Soulkin now offers seamless controller support for both combat and exploration.

[h3]🌍 Multi-Language Support[/h3]
Soulkin is now accessible to more players than ever, with new language options available at launch. Head into the settings to choose your preferred language! With more coming in the next months!

[h3]🧪 Free Demo Available Later Today[/h3]
New to Soulkin? You can now try the game for free! The demo gives a taste of the strategic combat and creature-collecting core that defines the experience.

[h3]📈 Refined Progression Flow[/h3]
Your journey now has deeper long-term structure, thanks to the addition of a fully implemented progression system.
[list]
[*]Unlock new squads and Nadia variants
[*]Upgrade your options between runs
[*]Shape future attempts with earned rewards
[/list]
This adds lasting impact to every run and encourages experimentation with new strategies and team compositions.

[h3]🧠 Smarter Combat, Smoother Balance[/h3]
Enemy AI has been sharpened, and we've fine-tuned core systems to make battles more reactive, tense, and strategic. Expect to think, adapt, and outplay your foes.

[h3]✨ Visual Polish & UI Upgrades[/h3]
Soulkin is more beautiful and readable than ever. From ability clarity to updated effects and smoother animations, every piece has been tightened to improve the experience.

[h3]🛠 Performance, Stability & Quality of Life[/h3]
We’ve resolved bugs, improved performance across machines, and added numerous quality-of-life enhancements—from clearer tooltips to snappier UI transitions.

[h3]💸 A Quick Note on Pricing[/h3]
As shared earlier, Soulkin’s price has been adjusted to $9.99 USD to reflect the scope and quality of the 1.0 version. If you supported us during Early Access—thank you from the bottom of our hearts. ❤️

[h3]🧡 Thank You, Community[/h3]
We couldn’t have made it here without you. Your feedback, bug reports, suggestions, and support have shaped the game into something we’re truly proud of.

There’s still more to come—but today, we celebrate this major milestone. We hope you enjoy exploring Ankiril, building your squads, and uncovering the secrets of Soulkin.

Now go forth, strategize, and save the realm!

See you in Ankiril,
—The Tambù Games Team

notes.title: Bugfixs and minor changes
Major Update: Heroes in Harmony
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/b61d08e1d24f4431092239864661b413cffeb664.png[/img]

[h1]February 17 - Heroes in Harmony Update (v0.12.0)[/h1]

Hello, everyone! We're excited to bring you Heroes in Harmony, our biggest major update yet (v0.12.0). This update brings massive improvements to Soulkin, refining progression, deepening strategy, and adding new ways to play. From custom squads to a revamped game flow, every run now offers more choice, challenge, and replayability!

[h2]New Features & Overhauls[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]A New Way to Play – Squad & Nadia Variant Selection[/h3]
At the start of each run, you now choose your squad from an expanding roster, unlocking new formations as you progress. Each squad brings a distinct synergy, encouraging new strategies.Additionally, Nadia now has multiple variants, each with unique abilities, stats, and mechanics that fundamentally change how you approach battles. Experiment to find the perfect match for your playstyle!

[*][h3]A Redesigned Map with Strategic Paths & a New Biome[/h3]
The map system has been fully reworked to offer branching paths that guide you toward the boss. Each route presents meaningful choices, letting you decide between risk, reward, and survival as you carve your way through each act. We’ve also introduced a brand-new biome, bringing fresh environments, enemies, and strategic challenges to your journey.

[*][h3]Soulkin & Nadia Now Level Up During Runs[/h3]
Combat now rewards growth! Both Soulkin and Nadia can gain experience, level up, and unlock new abilities mid-run, increasing their stats and granting new tools to tackle escalating challenges.

[*][h3]Upgradable Squads & Nadia Variants[/h3]
Beyond leveling up, both your squads and Nadia’s variants can be upgraded, unlocking new passive bonuses and enhancing their strengths for future runs.

[*][h3]Expanded Events, NPCs & Shops[/h3]
We’ve overhauled the event and shop system, introducing new NPCs, dynamic encounters, and revised mechanics that give you greater control over your progression. Expect new choices, surprises, and opportunities throughout each run!

[*][h3]Trinkets – Tactical Game-Changers![/h3]
We’ve replaced Artifacts with Trinkets, introducing one-time-use items that can be activated in battle to get you out of tight spots. Whether you need to block a devastating attack or boost your next move, these consumables add a fresh layer of strategy. Expect a variety of Trinkets to discover and use strategically throughout your runs.

[*][h3]Revised Action System[/h3]
The action system has been redesigned, making combat more dynamic and responsive. These changes improve battle pacing and decision-making, and we’ll continue refining the system in future updates based on player feedback.

[*][h3]Smarter Enemy AI & More Tactical Battles[/h3]
Enemy AI has been significantly enhanced, making foes more unpredictable and reactive. Expect battles that push you to think ahead, adapt quickly, and refine your strategies.

[*][h3]End-Run Summary & Unlock Preview[/h3]
At the end of each run, you’ll now see a detailed breakdown of your journey, alongside notifications of unlocked content, so you can track your progress and plan your next attempt.
[/list]

[h2]Important Note: Save Data Compatibility[/h2]

Due to the extensive changes in this update, all previous save files will be marked as incompatible and disabled. This ensures a smooth transition to the new systems and mechanics.

[h2]Coming Soon![/h2]
[list]
[*]Gamepad Support – development in progress!
[*]Expanded Language Localizations – more options coming in the next weeks.
[*]Demo Release – nearly ready! Stay tuned for announcements.
[/list]

We’re beyond excited for you to dive into this massive update! Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping Soulkin, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on these new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/076a8a12939174a9ef4c7e9fa84b8246e8cfdf3a.png[/img]

[h1]January 24 - News Update[/h1]

Hey everyone,

It has been a little over two months since our last update, and we wanted to give you a glimpse into what’s been happening behind the scenes here at Tambu Games. While we initially forecasted a major update for December, things didn’t go entirely as planned. However, we’ve been hard at work not just refining the game, but also revolutionizing parts of the experience to make it even better for you. As a result, we’re still working to patch everything together before releasing the next major update on Steam.

We’re excited to share a sneak peek at some of the features we’ve introduced and are polishing for this upcoming update:

[h2]Squad and Class System for Nadia[/h2]

We’ve added a brand-new system that allows for more control over your starting squad and Soulkins by introducing Squad and Nadia’s classes. This change will let players tailor their strategies right from the start of each run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/4c49b35cb767d627954b43134e188a3c529d8aa0.gif[/img]

[h2]Redesigned Map for Ankiril[/h2]

Exploration in Ankiril is getting a makeover! We’ve redesigned the map to offer a more classic and linear progression system. This provides a clearer sense of advancing through increasing challenges as you journey through the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/b5c356787c17d4d1bcded662a34a35624935e3f1.gif[/img]

[h2]Updated Studio Logo[/h2]

On a smaller note, we’ve updated our studio logo! It’s a minor change, but we’re excited to have a fresh look to represent our ever-evolving game and team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/5687fd51a84f70dd78375a42a75f77605a8c0315.png[/img]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

We want to assure you that we’re still alive and fully committed to making Soulkin an amazing experience. These past months have been a whirlwind of development, and while progress has taken a little longer than anticipated, it’s all in the name of delivering the best possible game.

Stay tuned for more sneak peeks in the coming weeks! 

We’re also gearing up to expand our testing efforts and will share details about how you can get involved in the next update.

Thank you for your patience and continued support—it means the world to us.

The Tambu Games Team

Major Update: Setting The Stage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/a328c79dcd79defa8f3fdd0a5451520a001b2038.png[/img]

[h1]October 26 - Setting the Stage Update (v0.10.0)[/h1]

Hello, everyone! We're excited to bring you Setting the Stage, our first major update (v0.10.0), packed with new features, improvements, and refined gameplay elements. Here’s a closer look at what’s new:

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Soulkin Promotion[/h3]
Enhance your Soulkin by promoting them during a run! Promotion boosts their stats and unlocks a new skill. To promote, go to the squad menu, select “Promote” next to your chosen Soulkin, have two other Soulkin of the same species, and pay an energy cost of Soulkin’s Soul value +1. Promoted Soulkin are marked with a star near their name and battle image.

[*] [h3]New Soulkin, Elite Forms, and Artifacts[/h3]
Meet two new Soulkin, joining your starting squad for every new run! We’ve also added four Elite forms for existing Soulkin and four new Artifacts to discover and collect.

[*] [h3]Save Slots[/h3]
You can now manage up to three save slots! Existing save data will be automatically moved to the first slot.

[*] [h3]Soul Signaling[/h3]
Hover over any Soul to see its linked Soulkin, making planning and organizing your strategy easier.

[*] [h3]Boss Battle Stage Effects[/h3]
See active stage effects during Boss Battles in the top-right of the screen, just under the battle objective.

[*] [h3]Multi-Language Support[/h3]
We’re rolling out expanded language options! Italian was added in v0.9.7, German in v0.9.9, and more languages will be available in the coming weeks.

[*] [h3]Updated Tutorial[/h3]
The updated tutorial, first introduced in v0.9.10, has been revised to make it even smoother for new players.

[*] [h3]In-Battle Signaling[/h3]
We introduced in-battle signaling in v0.9.10 as well, with this update improving clarity and functionality.
[/list]

[h2]Additional Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Demo Release[/h3]
The demo version is just around the corner, set to release in the coming days/weeks. Keep an eye out for a sneak peek at the game!
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Collection Rewards
[*] Minor graphical enhancements
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed map generation issue at the start of a run
[*] Resolved duplicate Collection Reward issue in a single run
[*] Fixed action points not clearing after a temporary boost to a Soulkin
[/list]

[h2]In Progress[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gamepad support
[*] Additional language localizations
[*] Final touches on the Demo
[/list]

Thank you all for being part of this journey! We’re excited to hear your thoughts and continue improving together.

notes.title: July 27 - Update (v0.9.2)
Soulkin is now available! Enjoy a 20% discount for purchases
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894006/d990bf1cdcdcfbfc6f95ab774fd89aa600e08b2d.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

[h3]🎉 Soulkin is now available in Early Access! 🎉[/h3]

To all our Soulkin adventurers, we have exciting news to share! After tireless efforts from our team, the world of Soulkin is now officially open to everyone!

Immerse yourself in Soulkin, a tactical monster-collector roguelite where you play as Nadia, a heroine summoned to save Ankiril. Collect unique Soulkin, engage in strategic turn-based battles on a hex grid, and defeat powerful foes to unlock new content and progress in the game.

[h3]:joystick: What’s New in Early Access:[/h3]

- [b]2 Playable Regions:[/b] Explore the diverse landscapes and uncover the secrets of Ankiril. 🌏
- [b]32 Soulkin:[/b] Discover and collect 32 unique Soulkin (8 per element) to unlock more content. 👾
- [b]12 Elite Soulkin: [/b]Challenge yourself by defeating 12 powerful Elite Soulkin (3 per element). 💪
- [b]6 Bosses:[/b] Face off against 6 formidable foes (3 per region) each with unique battlefield behavior. 💀
- [b]40 Unique Abilities:[/b] Utilize and face again a variety of abilities held by Nadia, Soulkin, Elites, and Bosses. 🔧
- [b]20 Artifacts:[/b] Find and utilize 20 artifacts spread among 3 levels of rarity to enhance your tactical options. 📦
- [b]6 Unique NPCs & 3 Map Events:[/b] Interact with NPCs and engage in map events that can be upgraded for additional benefits. 🌟
- [b]80+ Permanent Unlockables:[/b] Capture more Soulkin to unlock over 80 pieces of permanent content, evolving your gameplay experience. 🔓

[b]Special Offer:[/b] To celebrate our Early Access launch, Soulkin is available at a 20% discount for the [b]first two weeks[/b], so instead of paying 8.99$ (8.74€) you'll only pay [i][b]7.19$ (6.99€)![/b][/i] Don't miss out on this opportunity to embark on your adventure at a reduced price.

💭 Your Feedback Matters:
The feedback and suggestions we received during the demo were invaluable, and they greatly helped us optimize the Early Access release. We sincerely thank everyone who tested the game! We hope you will continue to provide feedback on any bugs or issues during Early Access. Your insights are crucial for us to continuously fix and optimize the game, making Soulkin even better!

If you encounter any problems or wish to leave feedback and suggestions, please share them directly in our discord server deciated channels. We review your input daily to ensure the best gaming experience for everyone.

We sincerely thank all Soulkin adventurers for your patience, companionship, and support. We hope you have an epic and thrilling journey in Ankiril!

You can also join our official Discord server to discuss the game and report issues!
[b]Discord server[/b] -> https://discord.gg/StmQ3sfqpD


Cheers,
The Soulkin Team
